questions.prompt: Select the model tier required for this prompt based on scope and execution environment:

options.luna: Self-contained, bounded task, single file/component, direct Q&A, or straightforward transformation.
options.sol: Multi-file/repository scope, agentic tool iteration, open-ended investigation, or system architecture.

questions.prompt: Select the minimum reasoning effort level required to complete the task accurately:

options.mid: Direct instruction, standard logic, routine edits, or simple context validation.
options.high: Moderate constraint satisfaction, multi-step verification, or edge-case handling.
options.extra_high: Deep architectural reasoning, concurrency/race-condition diagnosis, or complex system invariants.
